## Columns

One row per game. 37 columns. A row is identified by `game_pk`.

```{=html}
<div class="store-dict"><table class="table">
<thead><tr>
<th>Column</th>
<th>Type</th>
<th>What it holds</th>
</tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td>game_pk</td><td>string</td><td>MLB&#x27;s id for the game, the same id MLB.com and Baseball Savant use.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_date</td><td>date</td><td>Official date of the game; a suspended game keeps the date it started.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season</td><td>int</td><td>Season the game belongs to, as a four-digit year.</td></tr>
<tr><td>season_type</td><td>string</td><td>regular for the regular season, postseason for every playoff round.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_type</td><td>string</td><td>MLB game type code: R regular season, F wild card round, D division series, L league championship series, W World Series.</td></tr>
<tr><td>series_description</td><td>string</td><td>Series the game belongs to: Regular Season, AL Wild Card Series, NL Division Series, World Series and so on.</td></tr>
<tr><td>series_game_number</td><td>int</td><td>Number of the game within its series.</td></tr>
<tr><td>game_number</td><td>int</td><td>1 for a single game or the first game of a doubleheader, 2 for the second.</td></tr>
<tr><td>doubleheader</td><td>bool</td><td>True when the game was part of a doubleheader.</td></tr>
<tr><td>scheduled_start_utc</td><td>datetime</td><td>Scheduled first pitch in UTC.</td></tr>
<tr><td>originally_scheduled_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date the game was first scheduled for when it was postponed and made up later; blank otherwise.</td></tr>
<tr><td>resumed_date</td><td>date</td><td>Date a suspended game was finished; blank for a game completed the day it started.</td></tr>
<tr><td>status</td><td>string</td><td>Final, or Completed Early for a game called before the scheduled innings were played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>scheduled_innings</td><td>int</td><td>Innings the game was scheduled for: 9, or 7 for the 2020 and 2021 doubleheaders.</td></tr>
<tr><td>innings</td><td>int</td><td>Innings actually played.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the away team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team</td><td>string</td><td>Away team&#x27;s abbreviation.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_team_name</td><td>string</td><td>Away team&#x27;s full name as it was that season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_score</td><td>int</td><td>Away team&#x27;s final runs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>away_hits</td><td>int</td><td>Away team&#x27;s hits, counted from the play-by-play outcomes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the home team.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team</td><td>string</td><td>Home team&#x27;s abbreviation.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_team_name</td><td>string</td><td>Home team&#x27;s full name as it was that season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_score</td><td>int</td><td>Home team&#x27;s final runs.</td></tr>
<tr><td>home_hits</td><td>int</td><td>Home team&#x27;s hits, counted from the play-by-play outcomes.</td></tr>
<tr><td>winner</td><td>string</td><td>Which team won: home, away, or tie when the game ended level.</td></tr>
<tr><td>venue_id</td><td>string</td><td>MLB id of the ballpark.</td></tr>
<tr><td>venue_name</td><td>string</td><td>Name of the ballpark as it was that season.</td></tr>
<tr><td>day_night</td><td>string</td><td>day or night, as MLB classifies the start time.</td></tr>
<tr><td>first_pitch_local</td><td>string</td><td>Actual time of the first pitch on the ballpark&#x27;s local clock, 24-hour HH:MM.</td></tr>
<tr><td>temperature_f</td><td>int</td><td>Temperature at first pitch in degrees Fahrenheit, as announced in the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>weather</td><td>string</td><td>Sky condition at first pitch as announced in the box score (Clear, Cloudy, Roof Closed, Dome and so on).</td></tr>
<tr><td>wind_mph</td><td>int</td><td>Wind speed at first pitch in miles per hour, as announced in the box score.</td></tr>
<tr><td>wind_direction</td><td>string</td><td>Wind direction at first pitch relative to the field (Out To CF, In From LF, L To R, Varies and so on); blank when the box score lists none.</td></tr>
<tr><td>attendance</td><td>int</td><td>Announced attendance; blank when none was announced, including the 2020 games played without fans.</td></tr>
<tr><td>duration_minutes</td><td>int</td><td>Length of the game in minutes, not counting delays.</td></tr>
<tr><td>delay_minutes</td><td>int</td><td>Total length of weather or other delays in minutes; blank when there was none.</td></tr>
</tbody></table></div>
```

## Source and method

From the MLB Stats API (schedule, box scores, linescores, game notes). A postponed game appears once, on the date it was played, with its original date alongside; a suspended game appears once, on the date it started. Games that were cancelled and never played are not listed.

The same file layout, IDs and column names are used for every season, so seasons stack without cleanup. See [how the store works](help.qmd) for formats, delivery and the license.

[Player Game Logs](mlb-player-logs.qmd) · [Team Game Logs](mlb-team-logs.qmd) · [Play-by-Play](mlb-play-by-play.qmd) · [All MLB data](mlb.qmd)

::: {.faq-item}
### How do the MLB files join to each other?

On the ID columns. Game, team and player IDs are the same strings in every MLB file and every season, so a join on `game_id` (plus `team` or `player_id` where the grain needs it) lines them up.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### Which games are included?

Every regular-season and postseason game, built from the official game feeds and Statcast. Regular season and postseason sit in the same file, told apart by `season_type`. Preseason and All-Star games are left out.
:::
